description: Erection of a side extension incorporating conversion of existing garage. First floor side/rear extension. Alterations to front and rear elevations. Relocation of three roof windows and insertion of two roof windows. Increase height of existing boundary wall and fence and erection of railings. Erection of automated front gate.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Cover Letter Dated 3 November 2020, S01, S02A, S03, S04A, S05A, S06B Received: 3 November 2020; D01A,
D02, D03, D04, D05, D06 Received: 11 December 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Before the vehicle access is brought into use, the front garden wall hereby approved shall be constructed as per the approved drawings and shall be permanently retained thereafter with no obstructions to visibility above 600 mm high in a triangular area 2.4 metres either side of the centre line of the access and 2.4 metres deep into the site from the back line of the public footway at the site boundary and the railings hereby approved shall not be obscured by any solid barrier to visibility
